title: Fema / RBI | FEMA Penalty Reduced by 50% but Foreign Currency Confiscation Upheld: SAFEMA Tribunal
description: SAFEMA Tribunal sustains FEMA contraventions and confiscation but reduces Sanjay Jain’s penalty from ₹10 lakh to ₹5 lakh.The post FEMA Penalty Reduced by 50% but Foreign Currency Confiscation Upheld: SAFEMA Tribunal appeared first on TaxGuru.
